shooterExperience.description: A-17(10.5×12) — The National Target Company. Shooter registers individual shot observations against the original target face. The session must distinguish hits and misses only where governed object/region boundaries exist; show recorded shot distribution, repeat-session history, and measured progress without inventing a target-specific game or point system. Target-specific intended behavior and object inventory await full-artwork inspection.

shooterExperience.authorityLimitations: Identity matched by master #818. Evidence Only until governed region geometry and scoring are available. Existing authority is not overwritten. Missing scoring is a review issue, not automatically OOS.
shooterExperience.supportedExperience: Preserve every registered observation; show total shots, governed hits/misses where supportable, and history. No unsupported numeric score or unverified object-hit totals.
